title: Sylow reduction of a finite torsion module
statement:
Let $G$ be profinite, $\ell$ a prime, and $M$ a finite
$\ell$-primary discrete
continuous $G$-module. There is an open subgroup $H\subset G$
of index prime to $\ell$ such that $M|_H$ has a finite filtration
whose successive quotients are trivial $\mathbf F_\ell$-modules.

proof.text: The action homomorphism to units in End_Z(M) has finite image Q, since M is finite. Its kernel is the finite intersection of the open stabilizers in [def-exc-discrete-modules-category].

Choose an ℓ-Sylow subgroup P of Q via [lem-weil-pbc-sylow-subgroup-prime-index]. Its inverse image H contains the open action kernel, hence is open. Subgroup.index_comap_of_surjective identifies its index with that of P; Sylow.not_dvd_index and primality imply coprimality.

The restricted representation of P on M satisfies [lem-sc-primary-pgroup-filtration]. Pull its stable chain and successor conditions back along H→P. Its action on M is definitionally the original action, giving all clauses of the theorem.

split_report.summary: The finite continuous action factors through its finite image. An ell-Sylow subgroup gives an open inverse image of prime-to-ell index by the existing Mathlib leaf. The explicit annihilator-by-ell-power filtration has finite F_ell[P] quotients; the existing Lean-closed finite ell-group representation theorem filters each nonzero quotient. Inverse images and concatenation give the asserted filtration. The zero module and zero intermediate quotients are included. No new node is needed.

The Stacks source is 0A3R/0GIZ.

lean.statement: theorem exists_openSubgroup_primary_module_filtration (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G] (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, v} ℤ G) [Finite M.obj.V] (hM : IsPGroup ℓ (Multiplicative M.obj.V)) : ∃ H : OpenSubgroup G, H.toSubgroup.index.Coprime ℓ ∧ ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : Fin (n + 1) → AddSubgroup M.obj.V), Monotone F ∧ F 0 = ⊥ ∧ F (Fin.last n) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (g : H) (x : M.obj.V), x ∈ F i → M.obj.ρ (g : G) x ∈ F i) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (x : M.obj.V), x ∈ F i.succ → ℓ • x ∈ F i.castSucc ∧ ∀ g : H, M.obj.ρ (g : G) x - x ∈ F i.castSucc)
lean.note: Uses the landed discrete continuous module category over ℤ (abelian groups), rather than requiring a choice of finite coefficient ring. The quotient conditions are the exact elementwise criteria for annihilation by ℓ and trivial H-action; no dimension restriction is imposed.
